- **No .NET needed on Windows:** `PhoneDrop-1.3.0-win-x64.exe` has .NET built in, so there's nothing to install. Already have the .NET 10 Desktop Runtime? `PhoneDrop-1.3.0-win-x64-small.exe` is the same app in 0.4 MB.
- **Feedback from the apps:** ⋯ → *Send feedback* on Windows, *Feedback* on the phone. Bugs, ideas and questions go straight to the author.
- **Built in the open:** this and every future release is built from the public code by GitHub Actions, the APK signature is checked against the PhoneDrop certificate and `SHA256SUMS.txt` is generated there.
- Fixes for older Android versions (10–13): notification permission, installer results and screen insets.

Updating from 1.2.0 works in-app (Updates on the phone, ⋯ → Update on Windows). From 1.3.0 on, the Windows app updates to the same variant (full or small) it already is.
